summary: Turned the gap's divergence point into a measurable bounded check and stopped refining it. The probe now scans each side's own log store for the entry that side acknowledged and compares it with what that node's FSM applied, emitting applied_without_log for both the isolated node and the majority-side leader. Native runs show both acknowledged entries still present in their own logs two seconds after healing (minority_log_has_entry and majority_log_has_entry true, applied_without_log false on both sides), and the flag-off control shows the isolated side never had an entry at all — so no lost acknowledged entry and no applied-without-log divergence was produced in this schedule, and the mechanism that would truncate a losing suffix is not excluded. That bounded negative, with two divergence comparisons and its control, is submitted as an experiment (previous_id plus revision_reason recorded) for a retained receipt. The four established complete comparisons and the whole-question account are unchanged: conclusion violated, defect_claim asserted, with the new check noted in the rationale as under test and the limitation list updated so the divergence point is reported as unwitnessed rather than unreported.
